note: UI Styles Page applies UI Styles classes to a theme's regions. Configured at /admin/appearance/regions-styles/{theme} (permission administer themes, form RegionsThemeSettingsForm). Stored in <theme>.settings under third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions.<region> (each a ui_styles.selected_mapping {selected, extra}); constant REGION_STYLES_KEY_THEME_SETTINGS. PreprocessRegion merges classes onto the region attributes. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the live default-theme settings config.

evals.prompt: Using UI Styles Page, where in the Drupal admin do I apply CSS style classes to a theme's regions, and what permission is required?
evals.expected_output: Go to Appearance > Regions styles (/admin/appearance/regions-styles, then /{theme}); route ui_styles_page.regions.overview / ui_styles_page.regions.theme_settings. It requires the 'administer themes' permission.

evals.prompt: In UI Styles Page, which config object and key hold the style classes chosen for a theme's regions?
evals.expected_output: They live in the theme settings config <theme>.settings (e.g. olivero.settings) under third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions.<region_name>, each a {selected, extra} mapping. Constant REGION_STYLES_KEY_THEME_SETTINGS = 'third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions'.

evals.prompt: How do the region style classes configured in UI Styles Page get onto the actual rendered region markup?
evals.expected_output: A region preprocess hook (PreprocessRegion) reads third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions.<region> for the region being rendered and merges the resulting classes onto the region's attributes.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, UI Styles Page has been used to add a style class to the default theme's 'content' region. Inspect the live theme settings and give the extra CSS class applied to that region.
evals.expected_output: The class is ui-styles-eval-region: <default-theme>.settings has third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions.content.extra = 'ui-styles-eval-region'. Read with: drush cget olivero.settings third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use UI Styles Page to apply the CSS class 'ui-styles-eval-region2' to the default theme's 'content' region, and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set <default-theme>.settings third_party_settings.ui_styles_page.regions.content to {selected: [], extra: 'ui-styles-eval-region2'} (via the Regions styles form's Extra classes field for the content region, or config). Then flush caches.
